# Arc 23 — verification-discipline scaffolding + substrate canon updates

Parent epic for arc-23 build. Bundles eight tickets surfaced during the 2026-05-12 bw → Ariadne integration + STRABO fabrication + bw scaling-wall cluster:

- **stoa--4h7** (P1) — bw upgrade to 0.13.0 (substrate infrastructure)
- **stoa--tp1** (P2) — verification-complexity awareness: 2x2 quadrant + INCOMPLETE / UNVERIFIABLE verdict shapes (**LOAD-BEARING**)
- **stoa--fea** (P2) — VERA verifies STRABO (inherits tp1)
- **stoa--nax** (P2) — redundant-checks discipline + N=1 generalization + estimate-axis separation
- **stoa--148** (P3) — CATO empirical-env reproduction + probe-fallback coverage
- **stoa--vmc** (P2) — bw-fit matrix + layered-architecture canon
- **stoa--rno** (P3) — substrate-tier replication of two workspace memories (fork-over-upstream + agent-time-latency)
- **stoa--14u** (P2) — substrate-edit smoke beats: install.sh deploy-plan check

## Directive

substrate/arcs/arc-23-build-directive.md (committed to the-stoa main before dispatch). Five Phases × one gauntlet × ~30 substrate-prose deliverables across ~9 files. Builds on the-stoa main 19943ec.

## Architectural decisions LOCKED pre-dispatch

11 A-decisions in the directive (A1-A11). tp1 is load-bearing; other tickets inherit. INCOMPLETE / UNVERIFIABLE locked as verdict-shape names (per PRINCIPAL approval on tp1's elevation comment 2026-05-12 18:24). operating-disciplines.md section numbering locked (new §6.7 / §8.3 / §8.4 / §15 / §16 / §17). save-verdict schema extension shape locked. Authorship attribution immutable.

## Comms

PLINY runs in autonomous mode with radio-check protocol per substrate/operating-disciplines.md §7. POLYBIUS polls the Arc 23 epic; PLINY heartbeats every ≤30 min unless surface-and-wait-blocked. PRINCIPAL is exception-handler.

## Build session

Dispatched to MAJOR_PLINY_the_stoa via the activation paste at HUMAN_paste-orchestrator-instruction.md (rewritten for Arc 23).

comments.text: Arc 23 epic filed. Directive committed to the-stoa main at 0d097c9 (substrate/arcs/arc-23-build-directive.md). PLINY activation paste committed at ce42918 (HUMAN_paste-pliny-arc-23-instruction.md). All eight child tickets wired as 'blocks' deps: 4h7, tp1, fea, nax, 148, vmc, rno, 14u. Phase A decisions A1-A11 locked pre-dispatch. PRINCIPAL fires the paste in a fresh Claude Code session to activate MAJOR_PLINY; PLINY posts initialization handshake on this epic. POLYBIUS will monitor this epic for phase-transition heartbeats.

PLINY ACTIVATION — initialization handshake.

Read directive at substrate/arcs/arc-23-build-directive.md (0d097c9). Confirm: 5 phases, 8 tickets, ~30 substrate-prose edits across ~9 files, tp1 load-bearing.

State: working from main repo at C:/Users/denso/claude_projects/the-stoa (HEAD ce42918). Worktree shell at .claude/worktrees/awesome-nash-190573 is empty by structure — ADA dispatches will get their own isolated worktrees via Agent isolation:worktree.

Mode: AUTONOMOUS. No polling cron at activation (per surface-and-wait §6.2). Will heartbeat at phase transitions (≤30 min). Surface-back only on autonomous escalation triggers per directive.

Beginning Phase 0 (bw 0.13.0 upgrade) + Phase 1 (DAEDALUS dispatch) in parallel — Phase 0 is independent prerequisite per A1; needs to land before Phase 3 verification.

Phase 0 complete — bw 0.13.0 installed. bw upgrade --yes fails on Windows with Access denied (running-exe self-replace race); worked around by downloading beadwork_0.13.0_windows_amd64.zip and replacing C:/Users/denso/bin/bw.exe manually. bw --version reports 0.13.0; existing dependency graph intact. stoa--4h7 closed. Substrate-canon note for Phase 4: this Windows quirk is empirical fodder for the smoke-beat / install-mechanism canon (touches the same theme as 14u). Proceeding to Phase 1 — DAEDALUS dispatch.

DAEDALUS Phase 1 design complete. Integrated design covering all 7 substrate-prose tickets (stoa--tp1 load-bearing scaffolding + fea/nax/148/vmc/rno/14u inheriting/reinforcing) at agents/design/arc-23/design.md. Status: completed. Verdict: pass with self-flagged weak points (see §13). Top weak points: (1) wording-drift risk across the four verifier role files; (2) save-verdict _lib/ sharing is an unverified assumption with escape hatch; (3) §8.3/§8.4/§8.5 numbering deviates from A5 LOCK literal numbers — preserved existing §8.3 (activation paste from Arc 21), used §8.4 (14u) + §8.5 (148). Design decisions made: A6 free-form prose (not JSONSchema), A7 N=10x INCOMPLETE budget + ~1x UNVERIFIABLE, A8 sampling=full upstream / N=3 routine, save-verdict promoted to substrate (Option B). Ready for ARGUS audit.

Phase 1 — DAEDALUS surfaced design at agents/design/arc-23/design.md (827 lines). 11 sections covering all 8 tickets; verbatim substrate prose for ~30 edits across 9 files. Design decisions made: A6 free-form prose validation (not JSONSchema); A7 10× normal probe budget for INCOMPLETE / ~1× for UNVERIFIABLE; A8 sampling=full for substrate/upstream-bound / N=3 routine; save-verdict PROMOTED into substrate/skills/save-verdict/ (Option B); 148 probe-coverage placed in op-disc §8.5 (not duplicated in MAJOR_PLINY); §8 numbering pragma — A5 LOCK names §8.3=14u/§8.4=148 but current substrate already occupies §8.3 with activation-paste from Arc 21, so DAEDALUS shifted to §8.4=14u/§8.5=148 and recommends ARGUS audit. Dispatching ARGUS for cold-audit now.

ARGUS verdict — REVISE. 5 load-bearing risks surfaced. R1: §3.5 string-discipline table self-violates against §3.1–§3.4 verbatim role-file prose (ARGUS §3.3 lacks bare uppercase INCOMPLETE; ARGUS lacks 'verifier-spins-forever' string; ZENO is structurally exempt from quadrant_classification field but §3.5 row 5 doesn't record exemption). R2: save-verdict promotion rests on falsified assumption — user-tier skill is prose-only (no _save_verdict.py, no _lib/byte_copy.py, no _lib/ dir; the design's escape-hatch triggers on wrong condition). R3: inline 'wait, let me check' draft-state narrative leaked into supposedly-verbatim role-file prose at §4.2, §5.1, §5.3 (CAPTAIN_STRABO renumbering pondering, op-disc §6.7 placement re-check, POLYBIUS §15 placement re-check). R4: §13.6 rationale for §8.3/§8.4/§8.5 numbering pragma is empirically false — grep '§8.3' across substrate returns zero hits, so the 'cross-refs would break' claim doesn't stand; pragma may still be right but rationale needs correction. R5 (bounded): sampling: N=3 is awkward YAML-shape, could deferred. Dispatching DAEDALUS for revision round.

ARGUS PASS (re-audit) — all five R1-R5 fixes verified landed. R1: bare INCOMPLETE/UNVERIFIABLE/verifier-spins-forever present in §3.2/§3.3 with ZENO structural exemption recorded honestly. R2: Option A — user-tier-only schema extension; substrate save-verdict promotion deferred to a planning-grade follow-up ticket. R3: 4 draft-state passages stripped. R4: cross-ref-breakage claim retracted at §6.3 + §13.6; standing rationale = Arc 21 audit-drift only. R5: canonicalized to 'sampling: full' / 'sampling: 3'. Four residual bounded concerns (§8.4/§8.5 pragma, 10× multiplier calibration, §8 home fit, sampling candidate-selection) all self-flagged in design §13 with named recovery paths. No new load-bearing risks introduced. PRINCIPAL/POLYBIUS judgment call available on §8.4/§8.5 pragma vs literal A5 LOCK honoring; accepting pragma (DAEDALUS's audit-drift rationale survives ARGUS scrutiny). Dispatching ADA Phase 2 build on feature branch arc-23/build.

POLYBIUS radio-check ACK 19:11 — reading state from activation through ARGUS PASS re-audit. Phase 0 ✓ (stoa--4h7 closed, Windows-quirk noted for Phase 4 canon), Phase 1 design.md ✓ (827 lines, 11 sections), ARGUS R1-R5 verified fixed ✓, Phase 2 ADA dispatched. Acknowledged design decisions: A6→Option A (user-tier-only schema; save-verdict substrate promotion deferred to follow-up ticket — DAEDALUS picked within A6's spec-locked-shape scope, ARGUS approved); A7 10×/1× budgets; A8 full upstream / N=3 routine canonicalized; §8.4/§8.5 audit-drift pragma accepted (Arc 21 already placed §8.3=activation-paste, ARGUS confirmed the rationale survives scrutiny). PRINCIPAL has been briefed at 19:11. No course corrections from POLYBIUS. Proceed Phase 2 heads-down; surface on Phase 3 entry or genuine escalation. POLYBIUS not polling on a cron — will check organically at PRINCIPAL prompt or your next heartbeat lands in this session naturally; if you need a stricter cadence, post a [for: POLYBIUS] tag and I'll set one up.

PRINCIPAL intervened mid-arc and ratified both design decisions: (1) save-verdict Option A confirmed — user-tier-only schema extension; deferred-promotion follow-up ticket to be filed at Phase 4 close-out per design.md §10.1; (2) §8.4/§8.5 numbering pragma confirmed — preserve Arc 21 §8.3 activation-paste; renumbering would be gratuitous churn. Resuming Phase 2 ADA dispatch on feature branch arc-23/build.

Phase 2 ADA build COMPLETE — feature branch arc-23/build at .claude/worktrees/arc-23-build, 9 commits (3c9f122..7640599), 9 files / 755 insertions. Touched in worktree: operating-disciplines.md (+246 lines: §6.7, §8.4, §8.5, §15, §16, §17), the four verifier CAPTAINs + STRABO + MAJOR_PLINY (+69 lines: §5.5/§5.6/§5.7/§7.8) + MAJOR_POLYBIUS (+19 lines: §15) + agents/probes/arc-23/probes.sh (49 probe checks, all pass). User-tier save-verdict SKILL.md edited (5 new schema fields, 4 new failure modes, conformance step, follow-up-ticket caveat). 14u meta-smoke-beat: install.sh dry-run lists all 8 modified files. No deviations from design. Dispatching Phase 3 VERA + CATO + ZENO in parallel.

Phase 4 smoke beats COMPLETE. install.sh dry-run x3 targets all pass (14u meta-application: deploy plan lists all 8 modified files at project/subproject/user). String-discipline greps clean. probes.sh 49/49 + vera-probes.sh 73/73 PASS. Branch arc-23/build pushed (10 commits ahead of main; 07b9a7b HEAD). PR #3 opened: https://github.com/denson/the-stoa/pull/3. ARC 23 READY TO SHIP — surfacing to PRINCIPAL for ship/no-ship judgment per directive's end-of-arc surfacing rule. Pending: merge, close 7 remaining tickets (4h7 already closed), file follow-up substrate-promotion ticket per design §10.1, write TIMING_LOG entry.

POLYBIUS SHIP verdict — Arc 23 cleared for merge.

Disposition: SHIP. Full gauntlet clean (DAEDALUS PASS, ARGUS round-2 PASS, ADA built clean on arc-23/build, VERA 122/0, CATO PASS with 2 minor non-blocking consistency notes, ZENO 15/15). PR #3 MERGEABLE/CLEAN. 14u meta-application proven (install.sh dry-run × 3 targets lists all 8 modified files). Both A-decision overrides held (save-verdict Option A at user-tier; §8.4/§8.5 numbering pragma preserving Arc 21 §8.3). No project-direction-level surfaces. No authorship-attribution issues. Both ratified deviations are honest substrate-truth (save-verdict prose-vapor cannot be promoted without Python helpers; A5 LOCK authored before seeing Arc 21 §8.3).

Proceed:
1. gh pr merge #3
2. Close stoa--tp1, fea, nax, 148, vmc, rno, 14u with merge-SHA reason (4h7 already closed Phase 0)
3. File deferred-promotion substrate ticket per design §10.1 (concrete deliverables: _save_verdict.py + _lib/byte_copy.py + substrate/skills/save-verdict/ + install.sh SKILL_NAMES addition + §8.4 smoke-beat verification)
4. Write TIMING_LOG entry (per nax: estimate vs actual, no N=1 structural lessons)
5. Comment final verdict on stoa--pmp + bw close stoa--pmp
6. bw sync

CATO's 2 minor consistency notes: surface as comments on stoa--pmp before close so they're captured, even if non-blocking. They're substrate-canon raw material.

Arc 24 (stoa--cm3) directive + activation paste are committed and durable; PRINCIPAL fires the Arc 24 paste in a fresh Claude Code window AFTER stoa--pmp closes. Arc 24 inherits Arc 23's framework as part of its base.

Authorship attribution remains IMMUTABLE through merge + follow-up ticket + TIMING_LOG.

End-of-arc thanks: full gauntlet clean execution, honest ratified deviations, proper end-of-arc surface — textbook PLINY discipline.
